Q1.claim: hatch, load, dwell_or_propose, record_owner_answer, authorize_and_apply and install_checkpoint each hold the organism lock (organism.lock: POSIX flock across processes, serialized across threads, reentrant within a thread) from a currency check, through every change to memory, to the save.

evidence.caveat: load is a refresh: it holds the lock but performs no currency check and replaces a stale object rather than refusing it. Mutating operation entry checks were observed under lock.
evidence.run: trace all six public operation bodies plus _check_current while exercising them

evidence.scope: Lock ownership observed. This does not imply protection against same-thread reentry; R31b tests that separately.
